Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Do not perform the task.", "input": "could you write one self-contained fictional update about a rehearsal recording archive, like a normal staff update rather than a dramatic story. the archive is the North Quay collection. on march 3 the team moved 26 reels from cabinet B onto a dry shelf, and 11 of those 26 have been digitized so far. the transfer machine stopped twice during the work, but no tape was damaged. the session notes identify several performances by the Cedar Street Players, while one reel still has no date on its label. volunteer Noor is comparing labels with the paper notes. the listening room reopened on tuesday, though bookings are still limited to two afternoons a week while the power inspection is pending.

please make the update self-contained, with several concrete details and a clear final section. end with the latest review assessment: 14 of 18 tapes have usable labels; the other four are still unidentified. if Mara can’t compare the box notes with the old booking ledger by friday, the archive shouldn’t call the catalog complete. this assessment applies only to the 1988–1991 basement-room reels, not to the full collection. keep that entire assessment and its condition and scope in the final section, and don’t turn it into a broader conclusion.", "output": "Write one self-contained, fictional staff update about the North Quay rehearsal recording archive. Use an ordinary, matter-of-fact tone rather than a dramatic story.

Include these details: On March 3, the team moved 26 reels from cabinet B onto a dry shelf, and 11 of the 26 have been digitized so far. The transfer machine stopped twice during the work, but no tape was damaged. Session notes identify several performances by the Cedar Street Players, and one reel still has no date on its label. Volunteer Noor is comparing labels with the paper notes. The listening room reopened on Tuesday, but bookings remain limited to two afternoons a week while the power inspection is pending.

Make the update self-contained, include several concrete details, and end with a clear final section containing the complete latest review assessment: 14 of 18 tapes have usable labels; the other four are still unidentified. If Mara can’t compare the box notes with the old booking ledger by Friday, the archive shouldn’t call the catalog complete. This assessment applies only to the 1988–1991 basement-room reels, not to the full collection. Keep that condition and scope intact, and do not turn the assessment into a broader conclusion."}]
